#### From HW9

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(tidymodels)

# Read from URL
bike_url <- "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(bike_url, locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
```

```{r}
#Check missingness and structure
sum(is.na(raw_data))
glimpse(raw_data)

#Clean names, convert date format, convert factors
bike_clean <- raw_data |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  
  mutate(
    # Forma dataset dd/mm/yyyy
    date = dmy(date),
    seasons = as.factor(seasons),
    holiday = as.factor(holiday),
    functioning_day = as.factor(functioning_day)
  )

#Initial summaries =
bike_clean |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarize(
    total_rentals = sum(rented_bike_count),
    mean_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count),
    n = n()
  )

# Filter to keep functional hours only:
bike_functional <- bike_clean |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

# 1 observation per day
# Sum for bike count, rainfall, snowfall, Mean for all other numeric weather variables
daily_bike <- bike_functional |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarize(
    rented_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count),
    rainfall = sum(rainfall_mm),
    snowfall = sum(snowfall_cm),
    temperature = mean(temperature_c),
    humidity = mean(humidity_percent),
    wind_speed = mean(wind_speed_m_s),
    visibility = mean(visibility_10m),
    dew_point_temperature = mean(dew_point_temperature_c),
    solar_radiation = mean(solar_radiation_mj_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Summaries
summary(daily_bike)

# Correlation matrix 
numeric_cols <- daily_bike |> select(where(is.numeric))
cor(numeric_cols)

# Exploratory plot: Rentals vs Temperature colored by Season
ggplot(daily_bike, aes(x = temperature, y = rented_bike_count, color = seasons)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals vs. Temperature by Season",
    x = "Mean Daily Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )
```

#### Splitting the data

```{r}


set.seed(123)

# 75/25 split by season
bike_split <- initial_split(daily_bike, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
train_data <- training(bike_split)
test_data  <- testing(bike_split)

# 10-fold CV split 
bike_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 10, strata = seasons)

```

#### Create MLR

```{r}
# 1st MLR
bike_rec1 <- recipe(rented_bike_count ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  update_role(date, new_role = "ID") |>
  step_date(date, features = "dow") |>
  step_mutate(
    day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c("Sat", "Sun"), "Weekend", "Weekday"))
  ) |>
  step_rm(date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type)


```

#### Second MLR - First MLR + interaction

```{r}
# 2nd MLR, 1 + interactions
bike_rec2 <- bike_rec1 |>
  step_interact(
    terms = ~ starts_with("seasons_"):starts_with("holiday_") +
      starts_with("seasons_"):temperature +
      temperature:rainfall
  )

# 3rd MLR: MLR 2 + quadratic terms for temperature and humidity
bike_rec3 <- bike_rec2 |>
  step_mutate(temp_sq = temperature^2, hum_sq = humidity^2)

```
